title: Constructible finite-module closed-subscheme effacement
statement: Let $X$ be an affine scheme [def-weil-affine-spectrum, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $i:Z\to X$ a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion], and $\Lambda$ a finite commutative ring. Let $C$ be a constructible sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on the small etale site of $X$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves, def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf]. Write $U(C)$ for its underlying abelian sheaf [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. For $q>0$ and $x\in H^q(Z,i^{-1}U(C))$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology], there are a sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules $D$ and a monomorphism $b:C\to D$ such that $H^q(i^{-1}U(b))(x)=0$. No constructibility of $D$ is required.

source.place: Tag 09ZE, constructible case of the proof, using Tags 09Z7 and 09ZD

proof.text: Embed C into a finite biproduct A_j of finite pushforwards of constant finite modules M_j. Project the image of x to each summand after forgetting and restricting.

Apply the finite constant pushforward component theorem to each projected class. It gives finite surjective locally finitely presented covers pi_j:Yprime_j to Y_j for which the pushed-forward module units kill those classes.

Each module unit is monic by surjectivity. Right adjoints preserve monomorphisms, so their pushforwards are monic, as is their finite biproduct. Compose the biproduct map with the embedding to obtain b:C to D.

biproduct.map_pi and functoriality of H show that every projection of the cohomology image under b is zero. U is additive by its pointwise definition; inverse image is additive. Both preserve finite biproducts. Mathlib Abelian.Ext.addEquivBiproduct for the preserved bilimit is injective, so the full image is zero. The empty biproduct and zero ring require no exceptions.

theorem exists_constructible_module_mono_closed_cohomology_eq_zero
    {X Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine X] (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    (C : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (hC : Scheme.IsConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf C) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (x : Sheaf.H (((i)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).obj
      ((sheafCompose _ (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj C)) q) :
    ∃ (D : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (b : C ⟶ D),
      Mono b ∧ Sheaf.H.map (((i)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).map
        ((sheafCompose _ (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).map b))
          q x = 0
